claims: Adult male citizens required full civic rights; women, resident foreigners and enslaved people were excluded.
The 451 BCE rule required citizen parents; certain offences could remove rights.
Campaign service and distance from the city could prevent attendance; assembly powers included war, peace and alliances.
items.design: Equal-size category areas are not population shares. The meeting path starts only under the eligible category. No probability or exhaustive citizenship algorithm. The source's post-404 meeting pay is excluded from this selected focus.
